threads.body:
@copilot Update this PR directly with behavior-preserving Gradle cleanup. Consolidate suite registrations and execution configuration into a single testing.suites { ... } block per changed build file instead of separate top-level testing.suites.executions(...) blocks or redundant nested testing { suites { ... } } wrappers. Put custom-suite executions inside their registrations where appropriate. Preserve task names, source sets, dependencies, filters, default-only settings, variant-only settings, JDK gates, metadata profiles, and test coverage. Inspect all Gradle files changed by this PR for related simplifications of the migration, including unnecessarily global Test task configuration and redundant check wiring. Remove testLatestDeps system-property forwarding only after verifying that neither this module's test sources nor its shared fixtures read it, directly or through TestLatestDeps.testLatestDeps(); dependency-resolution declarations alone do not require forwarding. Keep a genuinely shared cross-suite or independent-Test setting in one declaration instead of duplicating it across execution blocks. The executions DSL permits only one executions block per suite; use its actual supported API. Do not edit agent instructions, knowledge/conventions documentation, or shared convention implementation. Keep the existing intended behavior and scope; avoid unrelated cleanup. Run the narrow relevant formatting and validation in your cloud environment and verify the resulting task configurations and coverage.

Apply this to all six builds already changed by this PR: Kubernetes client 7.0 javaagent, Redisson 3.17 javaagent, Vert.x Kafka 3.6/4/5 testing, and XXL Job 2.3.0 javaagent. The Vert.x Kafka 4 test and testNoReceiveTelemetry classes and shared Vert.x Kafka testing fixtures appear not to read testLatestDeps, so verify and remove that unnecessary forwarding. Vert.x Kafka 3.6 tests do read the flag and must retain it. Verify Redisson runtime consumers separately. Keep JDK gates common to defaults and experimental variants and preserve distinct receive-telemetry modes. Do not change any other PR or create a separate follow-up PR.

replies.body: Updated in 230699f0: consolidated the six suite configurations, removed Vert.x Kafka 4’s unused `testLatestDeps` forwarding, and retained the shared consumers and suite coverage. Targeted Spotless checks and Gradle task-graph validation passed.
